title: dual_regression
description: Dual regression algorithm to investigate group-ICA results

group_ic_maps.description: 4D image containing spatial IC maps (melodic_IC) from the whole-group ICA analysis
group_ic_maps.title: Group IC Maps 4D

des_norm.description: 0 or 1 (1 is recommended). Whether to variance-normalise the timecourses used as the stage-2 regressors
des_norm.title: Des Norm

design_mat.description: Design matrix for final cross-subject modelling with randomise
design_mat.title: Design Matrix

design_con.description: Design contrasts for final cross-subject modelling with randomise
design_con.title: Design Contrasts

n_perm.description: Number of permutations for randomise; set to 1 for just raw tstat output, set to 0 to not run randomise at all.
n_perm.title: Number of Permutations

thr_flag.description: Perform thresholded dual regression to obtain unbiased timeseries for connectomics analyses (e.g., with FSLnets)
thr_flag.title: Thresholded Dual Regression

output_directory.description: This directory will be created to hold all output and logfiles
output_directory.title: Output Directory

input_files.description: List of all subjects' preprocessed, standard-space 4D datasets
input_files.title: Input Files
